rust_summary: an editing mod asks before it spawns, removes or edits an entity (`native_mod_entity_edit`, `native_mod_entity_edit_allowed`).
doc_summary: `native_mod_entity_edit_allowed(player, dimension, action, entity_type, pos)` is what an editor mod (such as Axiom's spawn, remove and edit tools) asks before each `native_summon`, `native_remove_entity` or `native_entity_merge_nbt` it makes, with `action` `Spawn`, `Remove` or `Edit`. It fires `native_mod_entity_edit` (`kind` `spawn`, `remove` or `edit`) to every mod: a mod that sets `canceled` makes it return false, and the editor leaves the world alone. Returns true when no mod cancels, so a mod that never asks sees no change. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mod_entity_edit@.
